tools.description: Calculate BaZi from a known local Gregorian birth time and birthplace. Returns four pillars, luck cycles, ten gods, hidden stems and time correction. Each result includes source.url and attribution. No interpretation. Births at 23:00-23:59 true solar time take the next day's day pillar by default (day_boundary="midnight_00" keeps the same day). 返回八字四柱、大运、十神、藏干及时间校正；结果含 source.url 和署名。只排盘，不解盘。真太阳时 23 点后日柱默认归次日，可用 day_boundary 切换。

day_boundary.description: Day pillar for births at 23:00-23:59 true solar time: zi_hour_23 = next day (default); midnight_00 = same day / 23 点后日柱：zi_hour_23 归次日（默认），midnight_00 留当日
